n: Every answer an AI gives runs on chips in a data center, and many data centers use water to carry the heat away. That water comes from somewhere local: a river, a city system, or the ground underneath. When a data center is proposed near you, the useful questions are how much it will draw, from which source, and what returns to that source afterward.
